children: White House Deputy Chief of Staff Richard Walters is leaving the Trump administration as incoming White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller prepares to take over the staff. According to Odaily, Walters submitted his resignation on Friday, and the two sides agreed on his departure. He is the first senior official expected to leave in a round of staffing changes and has worked with outgoing Chief of Staff Susie Wiles for more than a decade.

title: Trump Administration Staffing Changes Begin as Deputy Chief of Staff Richard Walters Prepares to Leave
